status: UNVERIFIED PROPOSALS - not ground truth. Only entries in annotations.json confirmed by a human reviewer count as ground truth.
frame_index: 0-based, sequential cv2 decode order (same numbering as annotations.json and the pipeline)
method: Visual inspection by an LLM vision model (Claude) of frame-numbered contact sheets rendered with scripts/make_review_sheets.py: an overview every 15 frames, then dense strips (every 2-3 frames) around candidate events and around bending/fast-motion moments in no-fall videos. No output of the rule baseline or the ST-GCN was viewed for these 10 videos.

label_definitions.start: first frame of visible loss of balance / uncontrolled descent
label_definitions.end: first frame where the person is on the ground and the fall motion has stopped (limbs settled); matches the official Le2i Coffee-room convention
label_definitions.not_a_fall: deliberately sitting, bending, kneeling to pick something up

calibration: Before proposing, the same procedure was run blind on 9 officially annotated Coffee/Home videos (reports/pilot/PILOT_PROPOSAL_REPORT.md): fall/no-fall 9/9 agreement; start frames within -4..+7 frames; end frames were systematically 9-29 frames early under the earlier 'first contact' end convention, which is why the end definition above was adopted. The adopted end convention was not itself tested blind.

le2i/lecture_room/2.note: slow slumping collapse onto the mat from standing; partly controlled-looking

le2i/lecture_room/10.note: gets up from chair, trips over the mat, legs fly up

le2i/lecture_room/11.note: lurches toward mat, kneels, then collapses forward; start of uncontrolled phase ambiguous

le2i/lecture_room/23.note: bends to pick up a paper (f420-480), walks out; person out of view after ~f540

le2i/lecture_room/26.note: handles a bag at the table, bends to put it down (f525-540); out of view ~f945-f1200; no fall seen in visible frames

le2i/office/3.note: sits, stands up, steps and falls onto the mat

le2i/office/21.note: sits reading, stands, walks out fast (motion blur f350-390, upright)

le2i/office/29.note: stands at the table throughout, walks out near the end

le2i/office/30.note: walks in, sits and works at the table, stands, walks out

not_visible_definition: frames where the person is out of view (or too little of the body is visible to judge a fall); approximate (about +-15 frames), read from the overview sheets. No fall can be verified or ruled out there.
